title: Keep product language anchored
statement: As a developer joining or changing the product, I can look up a project term with its definition, related intent, and defining code so I use the team language and notice when it drifts.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A term exposes its name, definition, aliases, related stories and records, and defining source references.
When the defining source bytes change, the term is reported stale and identifies the affected term revision.
Suggestions for newly added enum values or typed constants are presented as optional growth rather than required work.
